item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SPF - Joint Enforcement Blitz Against Offenders with Deregistered Vehicles
item.description: As part of continued efforts to clamp down on the keeping and use of deregistered vehicles, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and Singapore Police Force (SPF) conducted a joint islandwide enforcement blitz in September 2026 and impounded 91 deregistered vehicles. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Reminder on Traffic Arrangements for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2026
item.description: The public is reminded of the road closures around the Marina Centre and Padang area from 7 to 13 October 2026 to facilitate preparations for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2026. Affected roads will be progressively closed from 12.01am on 7 October 2026. They will be fully opened by 5.30am on 13 October 2026. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: Sengkang-Punggol LRT Services to Fully Resume Earlier on 4 October 2026
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and SBS Transit will resume full train services on the Sengkang West Inner Loop from the start of passenger service on 4 October 2026, two weeks earlier than originally planned (i.e. 18 October 2026). This was made possible by the project team\u2019s efforts to further optimise the sequencing of upgrading works as they progressed, which enabled key works to be completed safely ahead of schedule. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by Ministry of Transport, Malaysia and the Land Transport Authority (LTA) - Grantors Informed by RTSO that RTS Link Service Commencement Targeted for February 2027
item.description: The Land Transport Authority of Singapore (Singapore Grantor) and the Ministry of Transport Malaysia (Malaysia Grantor) have been informed by RTS Operations Pte Ltd (RTSO) that passenger service for the Johor Bahru-Singapore Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link service is now expected to commence in February 2027. The revised timeline remains subject to RTSO obtaining independent safety certification for the RTS Link and securing final regulatory approvals. Please refer to the joint news release attached in this email for more details.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & Singapore Customs - Singaporean Man to Serve More Than 5 Years in Prison for Evading Duty and GST, and Underpaying ARF on Imported Motor Vehicles
item.description: A 48-year-old Singaporean man, Mah Chee Wern (\u201CMah\u201D) (\u9A6C\u542F\u6587), sole director of Karkaunsl Leasing Pte Ltd (\u201CKarkaunsl\u201D), was sentenced by the State Courts on 30 September 2026 for orchestrating a multi-year scheme to evade duty, Goods and Services Tax (GST), and Additional Registration Fee (ARF) on imported motor vehicles. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contracts for Tuas Road Viaduct (Phase 2)
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded three civil contracts with a combined value of about $1.2 billion for the construction of Tuas Road Viaduct (Phase 2) (TRV2), which will strengthen connectivity to Tuas port and support developments in Tuas South. Construction is expected to commence in early 2027 and be progressively completed from 2032. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: New Road Markings and Signs to Support Transition to ERP 2 from October 2026
item.description: From October 2026, motorists will progressively see new Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) road markings and road signs across Singapore, ahead of the launch of the ERP 2 system on 1 January 2027. With the transition to ERP 2, all Singapore-registered motor vehicles must be fitted with the ERP 2 On-Board Unit (OBU) to travel on public roads in Singapore. To date, more than 98% of eligible Singapore-registered vehicles have been fitted with the OBU. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & NYC - Youths Propose Ideas for A More Inclusive and Commuter-Friendly Transport System
item.description: The Youth Panel for Transport, comprising more than 35 youths, has developed proposals to make everyday journeys more inclusive, comfortable and convenient. The Panel presented its recommendations to the Minister of State for Transport, and Culture Community and Youth Mr Baey Yam Keng today, following three months of engagement organised by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the National Youth Council (NYC). For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SCDF - Launch of Online Poll on Differentiated Licence Plates for Electric Vehicles
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) will launch an online poll for owners of Electric Vehicles (EVs) and Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs) to indicate their preference for a differentiated EV licence plate design. There are three shortlisted designs to choose from. For more details, please refer to the attached joint news release.

item.title: 63 Organisations Recognised for Workplace Safety, Health and Environmental Excellence
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) held its 28th Annual Safety, Health and Environment Awards Convention (ASAC) today at Singapore Expo Max Atria, recognising 63 organisations for their outstanding workplace safety, health and environmental management practices. For more information, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: New Regulations on Public Buses and at Bus Interchanges/Terminals Implemented from 23 September 2026 to Foster a More Pleasant Public Transport Environment
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will introduce new regulations from 23 September 2026 to encourage positive commuter conduct on public buses and at bus interchanges and terminals. These will foster a safer, more considerate and pleasant public transport environment for all. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Improved Bus Connectivity for Commuters with More Services and Enhancements
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will introduce three new bus services and enhance two existing services in the coming months under the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme (BCEP). These enhancements will provide commuters with more travel options and improve connectivity in areas such as Tengah and Woodlands. To strengthen transport links and capacity for commuters in the Jurong region, LTA will also introduce interim Jurong Region Line (JRL) shuttle buses from mid- to end-2027, prior to the opening of JRL Stage 1. These shuttle bus services will broadly follow the JRL route and connect commuters to key station locations, with fewer stops for shorter journey times. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Waymo to be Singapore’s Newest Autonomous Vehicle Operator
item.description: Waymo will be Singapore\u2019s newest autonomous vehicle operator, joining ComfortDelGro and Grab. This deployment supports Singapore\u2019s approach to expand the range of autonomous mobility services and provide commuters with more transport options. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: North–South Corridor: Revised Completion Timeline Due to Complex Engineering Works and Challenging Ground Conditions
item.description: LTA has made steady progress on the North\u2013South Corridor (NSC), which will enhance connectivity from the northern region to the city. As of August 2026, more than 90% of the viaduct foundation works have been completed, with construction progressing to above-ground structures such as columns, crossheads and viaduct segments installation. For the tunnel section, over 90% of the foundation works have also been completed, with major excavation works ongoing across the 12.3km alignment. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: New Lodgement Service for Heavy Vehicles
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will introduce a new lodgement service for overnight parking of heavy vehicles from 15 September 2026, as part of an expansion of the existing Vehicle Parking Certificate (VPC) scheme. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), MOT & SPF - Further Strengthening of Singapore’s Regulatory and Enforcement Efforts against Deregistered Vehicles
item.description: The Ministry of Transport (MOT), Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the Singapore Police Force (SPF) will strengthen controls over the disposal of deregistered vehicles and enforcement against their use on our roads. The authorities have detected an increase in reported cases of deregistered vehicles used on our roads, from 75 in 2024 to 245 in 2025. The use of deregistered vehicles is illegal and poses serious risks to road safety, as these vehicles do not have valid insurance and are not roadworthy. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Road Closure and Public Transport Arrangements for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2026
item.description: The Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2026 will be held from 9 to 11 October 2026 around the Marina Centre and Padang area. As with previous editions, road closures will be required to facilitate set-up and removal of race infrastructure. The race organiser has put in place measures to minimise traffic disruptions. Road closures in the Marina Centre and Padang area will take place over seven days, from 7 to 13 October 2026. Please refer to the appended News Release for more information.

item.title: Factsheet: World Car-Free Day 2026: More In Every Move
item.description: In conjunction with World Car-Free Day 2026, the Land Transport Authority (LTA), together with government agencies, community organisations and industry partners, will organise a series of activities from September to November 2026. These include The Invisible City, an interactive gamified mobile experience, and Joo Chiat Car-Free Day on 3 October 2026. Through these activities, members of the public can discover more of Singapore by walking, cycling and taking public transport, while also connecting with the communities, heritage and public places around them. More information on the World Car-Free Day 2026 activities can be found on LTA\u2019s website.

item.title: Adjustments to the Heavy Vehicle Zero Emissions Scheme
item.description: With effect from 3 September 2026, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be adjusting the Heavy Vehicle Zero Emissions Scheme (HVZES) by reducing the incentive quantum from $40,000 to $15,000 for lighter zero-tailpipe emission heavy vehicles, i.e. vehicles with a Maximum Laden Weight (MLW) of more than 3,500kg and up to 7,000kg. This ensures that the scheme remains fit-for-purpose as more models of lighter zero-tailpipe emission heavy vehicles are now available in the market and the cost differentials between these heavy vehicles and their internal combustion engine (ICE) equivalents have narrowed. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates from 7 September 2026
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. LTA has been closely monitoring traffic conditions in the Orchard area. As congestion has persisted and traffic speeds have remained below optimal levels since October 2025, LTA will resume ERP operations for the Orchard Cordon on weekdays with effect from 7 September 2026. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Recognising Excellence in Public Transport Safety and Security, and Advancing Bus Safety
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is organising the Public Transport Safety and Security Awards (PTSSA) and Bus Safety Roadshow (BSR), bringing together public transport workers, operators and members of the public to celebrate excellence in safety and security, and to raise awareness of bus safety. For more details on the PTSSA, BSR and ongoing efforts in implementing Bus Safety Tripartite Taskforce (BSTT) recommendations, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Six Bus Interchanges to be Enhanced to Improve Commuting Experience
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will enhance six more bus interchanges as part of our ongoing efforts to make public transport more comfortable, family-friendly and inclusive. Enhancement works at the six interchanges \u2013 Bishan, Bukit Batok, Bukit Merah, Eunos, Punggol and Tampines \u2013 will begin in 2027. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Enforcement Operations Following Enhanced Active Mobility Regulations
item.description: Following the implementation of the enhanced regulations governing Personal Mobility Aids (PMAs) and Personal Mobility Devices (PMDs) on 1 June 2026, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has continued its enforcement operations to ensure compliance with the new rules and safeguard the safety of all path users. Between 1 June 2026 and 31 July 2026, LTA has engaged over 100 PMA users as part of efforts to share about the new regulations. Our enforcement officers also caught 3 users riding without a valid Certificate of Medical Need (CMN) or exemption, and 5 users speeding on a PMA. An additional 21 cases involving the possession or use of non-UL2272 compliant e-scooters were also recorded. Please refer to the attached factsheet for more details.\n

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SLA - Cross Island Line Phase 3 to Connect Jurong Lake District to Gul Circle with Four New Stations
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has announced the alignment and station locations for the Cross Island Line Phase 3 (CRL3). CRL3 will extend the CRL westwards from CR19 station in Jurong Lake District to CR23 station at Gul Circle, enhancing rail connectivity in Singapore\u2019s western region and cutting travel times. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Cross Island Line Trains: Features and Testing on Track
item.description: The Cross Island Line (CRL) will be served by a new fleet of 44 fully automated, six-car trains, with an option to procure up to 11 additional trains to support future ridership growth. The trains will be delivered progressively from 2027 ahead of the opening of CRL Phase 1 in 2030. For more details, please refer to the factsheet attached.

item.title: Factsheet: LTA to Study Bus Rapid Transit to Improve Public Transport Connectivity in Tuas South
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is studying the feasibility of introducing a new mode of public transport, the Bus Rapid Transit (BRT), in Tuas South to provide workers there with faster and more reliable connections from their workplaces to existing and future MRT stations. Tuas South has been selected for this study as it is home to major developments such as Tuas Port, and is expected to see further growth in the coming years. For more details, please refer to the factsheet attached.

item.title: Service Enhancements to Autonomous Shuttle Services in Punggol
item.description: The autonomous shuttle services operated by Grab and ComfortDelGro in Punggol have continued to see encouraging take-up since their launch. As of 12 July 2026, more than 11,500 unique riders have taken the autonomous shuttle services. Feedback has also been overwhelmingly positive, with 99% of around 900 respondents in the Land Transport Authority (LTA)\u2019s post-ride surveys in July 2026 indicating that they felt safe during the ride and would recommend the ride to others. In response to this feedback, LTA has been working with both autonomous vehicle (AV) operators to enhance the existing autonomous shuttle services before revenue operations commence. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Thematic Focus Group Discussions and Shadowing Studies Deepen Public Engagement for Land Transport Master Plan Refresh
item.description: As part of the ongoing refresh of the Land Transport Master Plan (LTMP), the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has engaged over 7,000 members of the public since November 2025 through online responses, focus group discussions (FGDs), youth engagements and community outreach events. Following the first phase of FGDs , over 400 participants participated in deeper discussions in the second phase of thematic FGDs and shadowing studies across our themes of Connectivity, Comfort and Community. In this second phase, we gained a deeper understanding of specific transport needs, including on topics such as access to cars, shared use of transport spaces, improving connections through micromobility and making public transport more inclusive. For more details, please refer to the attached news release. \n

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for August 2026 to October 2026
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for August 2026 to October 2026 will be 19,085. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Serangoon-Eunos Bus Package to SMRT Buses
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the contract for the Serangoon-Eunos bus package to SMRT Buses Pte Ltd (SMRT). The contract, estimated at a total fee of $599.5 million over a five-year contract period, will commence from 13 June 2027. LTA has the option to extend the contract by between two and five years at the end of the five-year term. \nPlease refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: Engaging Youths as Co-Creators in the Land Transport Master Plan Refresh
item.description: As part of the ongoing refresh of the Land Transport Master Plan (LTMP), the Land Transport Authority (LTA) is engaging youths to co-create and shape Singapore\u2019s future land transport system. Through dedicated platforms, LTA is gathering youth perspectives and ideas to ensure that long-term transport plans remain forward-looking, inclusive, and responsive to evolving needs. A key pillar of this effort is the formation of the Youth Panel for Transport, established in partnership with the Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY) and the National Youth Council (NYC). For more details, please refer to the attached news release.\n

item.title: Factsheet: Joint Enforcement Operations with Singapore Police Force to Target Non-Compliant Active Mobility Devices
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA), together with the Singapore Police Force (SPF), has stepped up enforcement against errant users of Active Mobility Devices (AMDs) through a nine-day joint operation conducted at identified hotspots such as key congregation areas, town centres and selected residential locations. During the operation, officers detected more than 200 offences and seized more than 100 AMDs and motor vehicles. This is one of the many ongoing collaborations between LTA and Neighbourhood Police Centres (NPCs) in estates such as Sengkang, Punggol and Yishun, to tackle active mobility offences at the ground level. For more details, please refer to the factsheet attached.

item.title: Update for Malaysia-Registered Taxis Entering Singapore
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) issues Public Service Vehicle Licences (PSVLs) and ASEAN Public Service Vehicle Permits (PSVPs) to Malaysia-registered taxis to provide cross-border taxi services between Singapore and Malaysia. Only Malaysia-registered taxis licensed with a valid PSVL and an ASEAN PSVP issued by the LTA are allowed to operate cross-border services between the two countries. The PSVP fee for Malaysia-registered taxis entering Singapore will be increased to SGD$15 per trip, up from the current SGD$2 per month, with effect from 1 January 2027. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.\n

item.title: Explore Three New Circle Line Stage 6 Stations on 4 July 2026
item.description: LTA invites commuters to a special public preview event of the three new Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) stations on 4 July 2026 from 9.30am to 9.00pm. Themed \u201CWhere Journeys Come Full Circle\u201D, the event offers a unique opportunity to explore the three new stations \u2013 Keppel, Cantonment and Prince Edward Road before they open for passenger service on 12 July 2026. For more details, please refer to the joint factsheet attached.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), BCA & MOM - Tanjong Katong Road South Sinkhole: Enforcement Actions To Be Taken Against Project Parties
item.description: The Building and Construction Authority (\u201CBCA\u201D), the Ministry of Manpower (\u201CMOM\u201D) and the Land Transport Authority (\u201CLTA\u201D) have completed their respective investigations into the sinkhole incident along Tanjong Katong Road South that occurred on 26 July 2025. Enforcement actions are being taken against the parties for their alleged involvement in the incident. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), NTWU, SBS Transit, SMRT, Go-Ahead Singapore & Tower Transit - Starting Salaries of New Local Bus Captains to Increase by $450 from 2027 With Further Increases in Sign-on Bonuses
item.description: To attract more local bus captains, the Government, in consultation with the National Transport Workers\u2019 Union (NTWU) and bus operators, will fund an increase in starting salaries of new local bus captains by $450 per month, with further increases in sign-on bonuses from January 2027. To manage wage relativity, improve retention and recognise the contributions of in-service bus captains, the bus operators have also collectively agreed with the NTWU to make a one-time adjustment to the salaries of all in-service bus captains. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Second Civil Contract for Changi Southern Corridor
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the second civil contract for the enhancement of road networks along Xilin Avenue, East Coast Parkway (ECP) and Tanah Merah Coast Road (TMCR), as part of the Changi Southern Corridor project, to a joint venture between CES_SDC Pte. Ltd. and KTC Civil Engineering & Construction Pte. Ltd. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates from 2 June 2026
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. There will be a school holiday discount of ERP rates at six locations for 18 specified time periods during the June school holiday period from 2 June to 28 June 2026. These locations and time slots were identified in anticipation of lower traffic demand. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by Land Transport Authority (LTA) & MHA - Denying Vehicle Entry Permit Applications for Foreign-Registered Vehicles with Outstanding Fines
item.description: All foreign-registered vehicles must have a valid Vehicle Entry Permit (VEP) for entry into Singapore. From 2 November 2026, foreign-registered vehicles with outstanding fines for traffic, parking or vehicular emissions offences committed in Singapore will not be able to apply for or renew their VEP with the Land Transport Authority (LTA). For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Circle Line Stage 6 to Open for Public Preview on 4 July 2026
item.description: Commuters will be able to preview and enjoy free travel between Keppel, Cantonment and Prince Edward Road stations during the CCL6 public preview on 4 July 2026 from 9.30am to 9.00pm. Following the public preview, Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) will open for passenger service on 12 July 2026. The opening of three new stations \u2013 Keppel, Cantonment and Prince Edward Road \u2013 will complete the Circle Line by connecting HarbourFront station to Marina Bay station. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Three Individuals Charged for Using Deregistered Vehicles
item.description: LTA is taking enforcement action against three persons for their alleged involvement in using deregistered vehicles in separate cases. These cases are part of LTA\u2019s continued efforts to crack down on offences involving deregistered vehicles. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Trial of New Road Signs and Markings under ERP 2
item.description: To test the effectiveness of the new ERP road signs and markings, LTA is conducting a user experience study. LTA has refined the designs of the ERP road signs and markings for the second phase of the study, taking into account feedback from the first phase. Five different combinations of road signs and markings will be tested across five expressways and arterial roads. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & Singapore Customs - Company Director Fined Over $1 Million for Evading Duty and GST on Imported Motor Vehicles
item.description: Singapore, 5 May 2026 \u2013 The director of Concordway Pte Ltd (\u201CConcordway\u201D), Mr Thiyambarawatta Subash Indrajith (\u201CSubash\u201D), was fined $1,068,000 by the State Courts on 24 April 2026 for fraudulent evasion of duty by declaring suppressed values for 34 motor vehicles imported into Singapore between October 2018 and February 2024. The 59-year-old Singaporean has until 25 May 2026 to pay the fine for his Customs offences, failing which he will serve 12 months and two weeks\' imprisonment in default. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Award of First Cross-Border Ride-Hail Service Operator Licence to Enhance Cross-Border Connectivity between Singapore and Malaysia
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the first Cross-border Ride-hail Service Operator Licence (CRSOL) to GrabCar Pte Ltd. The licence will be valid for three years, commencing from 30 April 2026. The introduction of the CRSOL will bring about greater convenience and more transport options for commuters between Singapore and Malaysia. This development reflects Singapore and Malaysia\'s continued commitment to improving cross-border connectivity and commuting experience for travellers between both countries. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SBS Transit & SMRT - Train Service Adjustments along Thomson-East Coast Line and Downtown Line to Facilitate Rail Expansion Works
item.description: In the lead up to the opening of Stage 5 of the Thomson-East Coast Line (TEL) and the extension of the Downtown Line (DTL), train services along the TEL and DTL will be adjusted on weekends from 22 May to 4 Jul and 10 Jul to 5 Sep 2026 respectively to facilitate the integration of new line segments into the existing network. To minimise inconvenience to commuters, alternative travel options will be provided during these service adjustment periods. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Reminder: Enhanced Active Mobility Regulations to Take Effect from 1 June 2026
item.description: The enhanced regulations governing Personal Mobility Aids (PMAs) and Personal Mobility Devices (PMDs) will take effect from 1 June 2026. These measures aim to curb misuse of mobility scooters by able-bodied individuals, improve path safety, and reduce fire risks from non-compliant devices. LTA urges users and retailers to familiarise themselves with the new requirements and take the necessary steps ahead of 1 June 2026. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for May 2026 to July 2026
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for May 2026 to July 2026 will be 19,052. The COE quota for May 2026 to July 2026 is 1% more than the previous quarter (February 2026 to April 2026). For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & Singapore Customs - Two Singaporean Men Sentenced to Over $2.6 Million Fine for Evading Duty and GST on Imported Motor Vehicles
item.description: Two Singaporean men were sentenced by the State Courts to a total fine of more than $2.6 million for under-declaring the values of motor vehicles, which resulted in the fraudulent evasion of excise duties, Goods and Services Tax (GST) and the underpayment of the Additional Registration Fee (ARF) during registration of the vehicles. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & CASE - CASE and LTA Launch Accreditation Scheme for Singapore’s Car-Sharing Industry
item.description: Consumers renting from accredited car-sharing operators will soon have greater assurance of well-maintained and roadworthy vehicles by looking for the CaseTrust mark. This follows the launch today of a new CaseTrust accreditation scheme for the car-sharing industry by the Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) and the Land Transport Authority (LTA). For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & Enterprise Singapore - Singapore Elevates National Standard for Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Systems to Support Safer and More Reliable Charging Infrastructure
item.description: To support the continued expansion of Singapore\u2019s electric vehicle (EV) charging network and the adoption of emerging charging technologies, the national EV charging standard, Technical Reference 25 (TR25:2022) will be elevated to a Singapore Standard, SS 722 with effect from 1 April 2026. For more details, please refer to the joint factsheet attached.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Train Service Adjustments in Preparation for Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) Opening
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and SMRT will complete the Circle Line (CCL) tunnel strengthening works ahead of schedule \u2013 by 10 April 2026, instead of 19 April 2026 as previously announced. With the completion of tunnel works, we will proceed with the final systems integration testing works in preparation for the opening of CCL6. CCL6 comprises, three new stations on the southern stretch of CCL and will close the circle of the CCL. To facilitate these testing works, train services on the CCL will be adjusted during the weekends from 11 April 2026 to 17 May 2026, with earlier closures on Saturday nights, and later openings on Sunday mornings. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SCDF - Launch of Stakeholder Engagement on Differentiated Licence Plates for Electric Vehicles
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) intend to implement differentiated licence plates for Electric Vehicles (EVs), including plug-in hybrid EVs (PHEVs), and will commence a stakeholder engagement exercise to gather feedback on the proposed design and implementation approach. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Retailer to be Charged for Illegal Modification of Personal Mobility Device
item.description: The director of YY Scooter Pte Ltd, which operates under the shop name \u201CYY E-Bike\u201D, and the store manager of YY E-Bike Pte Ltd (\u201CYY E-Bike\u201D) will each be charged in court on 19 March 2026 for one count of allegedly providing illegal modification services on a Personal Mobility Device (PMD) by fitting an additional battery to the PMD, under Section 35 of the Active Mobility Act 2017. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Final Civil Contract for the Downtown Line 2 Extension
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the final civil contract for the Downtown Line 2 extension (DTL2e), which is for the design and construction of the tunnels between the existing Bukit Panjang station and the upcoming DE1 station on the DTL2e. It has been awarded to China Railway Tunnel Group Co. Ltd. (Singapore Branch) at a contract value of around $199 million. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates from 23 March 2026
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & Singapore Customs - Singaporean Man to Serve More Than 9 Years In Prison for Evading Duty and GST on Imported Motor Vehicles
item.description: The director of Crownston Line Pte Ltd (\u201CCrownston\u201D) at the material time, Lee Clement (\u201CLee\u201D), was fined $14 million on 25 February 2026 for fraudulent evasion of duty by suppressing the declared values of 2,523 motor vehicles imported into Singapore between July 2016 and April 2022. Lee did not pay the fine for his Customs offences and will serve 112 months\' imprisonment in default. Lee, a 44-year-old male Singaporean, pleaded guilty to eight charges under the Customs Act for fraudulent evasion of duty amounting to about $5,197,564. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Factsheet: The Next Phase of Rail Development
item.description: LTA will complete the final stages of works and open the Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6), Downtown Line 3 extension (DTL3e), and Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 5 (TEL5) this year. Construction works for the Cross Island Line Phase 3 (CRL3) are planned to commence next year. Engineering studies for the first phases of the Seletar Line, Tengah Line and West Coast Extension of the Jurong Region Line, are planned to commence this year. Please refer to the factsheet for more information.

item.title: Autonomous Shuttle Services in Punggol Open for Public Rides from 1 April 2026
item.description: From 1 April 2026, members of the public will be able to ride autonomous shuttle in Punggol. The autonomous shuttles operated by Grab in Punggol have undergone extensive testing, accumulating over 25,000 km of safe and reliable autonomous driving. Since by-invite community rides commenced on 12 January 2026, around 740 people have taken these autonomous shuttles. 99% shared positive feedback that they would recommend the service to others. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: MOT-LTA Joint News Release: Additional Measure for Safer Worker Transportation
item.description: From 1 Jan 2027, MOT and LTA will ban the ferrying of workers in caged lorry decks. This is part of the Government\u2019s continuous efforts to enhance the safety of worker transportation. It follows engagements with various industry and Non-Governmental Organisation (NGO) stakeholders. Companies can continue to use caged lorries for the transportation of goods and equipment. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: LTA Shares Insights from LTMP Focus Group Discussions
item.description: Since the start of the public consultation for the Land Transport Master Plan (LTMP) refresh on 15 November 2025, the Land Transport Authority has received over 3,500 responses from members of the public. Participants from diverse backgrounds shared their aspirations for Singapore\'s transport future. Over 200 participants joined the first series of six focus group sessions held from 17 January to 12 February 2026, where they shared their commuting experiences and views to help shape the next phase of our land transport system to better meet evolving needs and aspirations of Singaporeans. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: 8% of NEL Commuters Shift Out of Morning Peak and Travel Smart Journeys Participation More Than Doubles
item.description: About 8% of commuters on the North East Line have shifted out of the morning peak period (between 7.30am and 9.00am) since the launch of the free morning off-peak rail rides and enhanced Travel Smart Journeys (TSJ) programmes on 27 December 2025. Participation in TSJ has also more than doubled over the same period. Together, these measures help to moderate travel demand during the morning peak and improve the commuting experience for commuters in the North-East. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SMRT & SBS Transit - Train Service Adjustments along East-West Line and Sengkang-Punggol LRT to Facilitate Upgrading Works
item.description: Train services along the East-West Line (EWL) and Sengkang-Punggol LRT (SPLRT) will be adjusted to facilitate essential upgrading works that will enhance the capacity, reliability and resilience of the rail network. During this period, commuters are advised to plan their journeys ahead and factor in additional travelling time during the service adjustment period. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Two Civil Contracts for the Downtown Line 2 Extension
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded two civil contracts for the Downtown Line 2 extension (DTL2e). The first contract was awarded for the design and construction of an underground station (DE1) located along Sungei Kadut Avenue. The second contract, for the design and construction of the NS6\/DE2 interchange station, involves the construction of an underground DE2 station on the DTL and a connected aboveground NS6 station between the Yew Tee and Kranji stations on the North-South Line. Please refer to the news release for more details.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SMRT & SBS Transit - LTA and Rail Operators Will Progressively Implement Rail Reliability Taskforce Recommendations to Strengthen Overall Network Reliability
item.description: The Rail Reliability Taskforce will start implementing a series of recommendations to strengthen rail reliability. These initiatives will be progressively rolled out over the next few years across the rail network. The Taskforce was formed on 19 September 2025 to develop and implement immediate solutions to improve rail reliability and joint responses to train service disruptions. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Revision of Preferential Additional Registration Fee (PARF) Rebate Schedule and Cap
item.description: As announced by Prime Minister and Minister for Finance Lawrence Wong in the Budget 2026 Statement, there will be revisions to the Preferential Additional Registration Fee (PARF) rebate schedule and cap for cars and taxis. PARF is intended to encourage the timely renewal of the vehicle population so that it is safer and less pollutive. Electric Vehicles (EVs) are less pollutive than conventional petrol cars. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: More Improvements Under the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme in 2026
item.description: The Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme (BCEP) was introduced in July 2024 to enhance bus connectivity, especially in newer estates located further from MRT stations, and offer alternative travel modes along rail lines with high ridership. Since its launch, LTA has introduced 27 new and extended bus services and enhanced 62 existing services to improve connectivity. These include new express bus services to and from the city and limited-stop bus services that take a faster route to MRT stations. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Bus Arrival Time Predictions Returning to Normal
item.description: As of today, the availability of bus arrival timings has been restored to above 90%. Instances of missing arrival timings or longer headways are expected to continue to decrease as the Expected Time of Arrival (ETA) system performance stabilises. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Updates for Foreign-Registered Vehicles Entering Singapore
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) periodically reviews the fees for foreign-registered vehicles in Singapore to account for changes in ownership and usage costs of Singapore-registered vehicles. This is to ensure that the cost of owning and using a foreign registered vehicle in Singapore is commensurate with that of a Singapore-registered vehicle. The cost difference has widened in recent years, giving rise to the need to increase the Vehicle Entry Permit (VEP) fee for foreign-registered cars and motorcycles and the Goods Vehicle Permit (GVP) fee for foreign-registered goods vehicles. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Two-Year Trial to Suspend Vehicle Parking Certificate Requirement for Trailers Starts 6 February 2026
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will suspend the Vehicle Parking Certificate (VPC) requirement for trailers (including container trailers, low loaders and flat-bed trailers) for a trial period of two years, from 6 February 2026 to 5 February 2028. The trial was initiated in consultation with the Singapore Transport Association, in response to feedback from heavy vehicle (HV) and trailer owners. For more details, please refer to the news release attached.

item.title: Amendments to the Road Traffic Act to Facilitate ERP2 Transition and Enhance Penalties for Vehicle Safety
item.description: From 1 January 2027, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will transition to use the ERP 2 system for road use charging, and all Singapore-registered motor vehicles must have the ERP 2 system\u2019s On-Board Unit (OBU) installed to travel on public roads in Singapore. To streamline the collection of missed ERP charges, LTA will decriminalise missed ERP payments and treat them as an administrative matter. Penalties for illegal alteration of motor vehicles, and for keeping or using unregistered\/deregistered vehicles have also been enhanced to strengthen deterrence and improve vehicle and road safety. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Tighter Active Mobility Regulations to Curb Misuse of Personal Mobility Aids and Enhance Fire Safety from 1 June 2026
item.description: From 1 June 2026, new regulations governing Personal Mobility Aids (PMAs) and Personal Mobility Devices (PMDs) will come into effect. Mobility scooter users must have a valid Certificate of Medical Need, with exemptions for seniors aged 70 and above, along with other qualifying groups such as beneficiaries of subsidised mobility scooters, and those under Ministry of Health (MOH) disability schemes. New mobility scooters must be registered, and it will be an offence to keep non-UL2272 certified e-scooters. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Media Statement on Incident at Edgedale Plains on 17 January 2026
item.description: LTA and ComfortDelGro have reviewed the incident on 17 January 2026 where an autonomous vehicle (AV) undergoing road tests had a minor collision with a road divider along Edgedale Plains. The review concluded that the AV detected an object that was not on the road. In response, the AV correctly manoeuvred into the adjacent lane as a precaution. For additional details, please refer to the attached media statement.

item.title: Expected Time of Arrival (ETA) System Update: Majority of Services Available
item.description: As of today, LTA has completed the manual updating of firmware for the 3,000 buses that were identified last week. The availability of bus arrival timings will be restored to 85% by tomorrow morning, with the ETA system expected to be fully restored by early next week. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & TP - More Convenience for Elderly Vocational Licence Drivers Through Streamlined Medical Examination Process
item.description: The Traffic Police (TP) and the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be introducing the new Harmonised Medical Examination Report (HMER) on 2 February 2026, to simplify and make more convenient the medical assessment process for elderly vocational licence (VL) drivers. Under current regulations, TP requires drivers aged 65 and older with Class 2 or Class 3 licences to undergo a medical examination every three years, and annually for those with Class 4 or Class 5 licences. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint Exercise by LTA and Public Transport Operators to Ensure Operational Readiness in Managing Rail Incidents
item.description: The Land Transport Authority conducted a joint ground deployment exercise with rail operators SBS Transit and SMRT at Serangoon MRT station interchange earlier today. Codenamed \u2018Exercise GREYHOUND 2026\u2019, the exercise was conducted during engineering hours this morning and plays a key role in our ongoing efforts to maintain a high level of operational readiness in managing major incidents in the public transport network. This is the 11th edition of Exercise GREYHOUND since its inauguration in 2012. For more details, please refer to the attached release.

item.title: LTA and Public Transport Operators Enhance Rail Service Recovery and Commuter Management Measures in line with Rail Reliability Taskforce Recommendations
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA), together with the public transport operators SMRT and SBS Transit, have been implementing various enhanced initiatives to strengthen rail service recovery and better support commuters during service disruptions. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Factsheet: First Series of Focus Group Discussions for Land Transport Master Plan Refresh Underway
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) conducted a Focus Group Discussion session today as part of a year-long public engagement under the Land Transport Master Plan (LTMP) refresh. The session was hosted by Minister of State for Transport, and Culture, Community and Youth Mr Baey Yam Keng. Participants from diverse backgrounds including elderly residents, families with caregiving needs, working adults, and youths had registered their interest through the LTMP refresh webpage. Please refer to the media factsheet attached for more information.\n

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for February 2026 to April 2026
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for February 2026 to April 2026 will be 18,824. Overall, the COE quota for February 2026 to April 2026 is 1% lower than the previous quarter (November 2025 to January 2026). For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Identifies Root Cause of ETA System; Progressive Restoration Underway
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has identified the root cause of the intermittent transmission issue affecting the Expected Time of Arrival (ETA) System for buses. Following a system reset at 8pm on 21 January, our engineers and ETA system contractor discovered a memory cache build-up in the on-board systems of some buses. This disrupted data transmissions between on-board bus systems and the central ETA processing servers, leading to missing bus arrival timings. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Buses Operating as Usual; LTA Investigating Technical Issues Affecting Expected Time of Arrival (ETA) System
item.description: The Land Transport Authority is currently investigating technical issues affecting the Expected Time of Arrival (ETA) system for buses, which has resulted in inaccurate bus timings and long wait times displayed at commuter touchpoints. Bus operations are not affected and all services continue to operate at their usual frequencies. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: ETA System Reset From 21 January 2026, 8pm; Bus Services Continue To Operate as Usual
item.description: The Land Transport Authority\u2019s (LTA) preliminary findings on the technical issues affecting the Expected Time of Arrival (ETA) system for buses indicate that there is an intermittent transmission issue with the on-board systems for some buses, which resulted in missing bus arrival predictions for a small proportion of buses across our bus network. For additional details, please refer to the attached media statement.

item.title: LTA Awards First Civil Contract for the Downtown Line 2 Extension
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the first civil contract for the Downtown Line 2 extension (DTL2e). This contract is for the design and construction of tunnels between DE1 station and DE2 interchange station on DTL2e. The contract includes the construction of two mainline tunnels and a tunnel connection to Gali Batu Depot, along with associated additions and alterations works within the depot. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Reminder on Train Service Adjustments to Circle Line for Tunnel Works from 17 January to 19 April 2026
item.description: Commuters are reminded that from 17 January to 19 April 2026, LTA is undertaking essential tunnel strengthening works in two tunnels connecting Mountbatten, Dakota and Paya Lebar stations on the Circle Line (CCL). During this period, shuttle trains will operate on a single platform between Paya Lebar and Mountbatten stations using one tunnel, at headways of 10 minutes. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint Media Statement by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), NTUC, ComfortDelGro, Grab & STRIDES Premier - Tripartite Response to Help Drivers Affected by Recent Vehicle Repossessions
item.description: Autobahn Rent A Car creditors have recently repossessed vehicles from a number of private hire drivers, leaving many drivers without the means to continue earning a living. In response, NTUC-affiliated associations, the National Private Hire Vehicles Association (NPHVA) and the National Taxi Association (NTA) called for a tripartite response, and have been working with the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and platform operators ComfortDelGro (CDG), Grab, and STRIDES Premier to secure immediate support for affected drivers. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contract for Design and Construction of NS3A Station and Viaduct on Existing North-South Line
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the civil contract for the design and construction of the new North-South Line (NSL) NS3A station and viaduct to Obayashi Corporation at a contract value of around $281 million. Construction works for the NS3A station and viaduct are expected to start in the first half of 2026, and passenger service for the station is targeted to commence in 2034. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SMRT & SBS Transit - Rail Reliability Taskforce Submits its Recommendations
item.description: The Rail Reliability Taskforce has submitted its recommendations on enhancing the reliability of our rail system to the Acting Minister for Transport. The attached news release has a summary of the recommendations.

item.title: LTA Converts Geolah and Trans-Cab’s Provisional Licences to Full Ride-Hail Service Operator Licences, Offering More Ride-Hailing Choices
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has converted Geo Lah Pte Ltd (Geolah)\u2018s and Trans-cab Services Pte Ltd (Trans-Cab)\u2019s existing 1-year provisional licences for Point-to-Point transport (P2P) services to full 3-year Ride-hail Service Operator Licences (RSOL). For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.\n

item.title: Temporary Relocation of Five Bus Services to Facilitate Upgrading of Sengkang Bus Interchange
item.description: Since August 2024, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has begun to progressively upgrade Sengkang Bus Interchange to enhance facilities for commuters and transport staff. These works include upgrading of mechanical and electrical services, concourse refurbishment and overhaul of the bus interchange driveway for waterproofing works. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: More Electric Buses to be Deployed from End-2026
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded six contracts for 660 new electric buses, comprising 360 single-deck and 300 double-deck buses. The awarded tenderers are ST Engineering Mobility Services (partnered with CRRC), BYD, Yutong and Cycle & Carriage Automotive (partnered with Zhongtong Bus). Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Singapore’s Overall Rail Reliability Performance Remains High
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) released its October update of the rail reliability report today. Our overall rail reliability performance continues to remain high across all indicators, including Mean Kilometres Between Failure (MKBF) and the new indicators, Train Service Delivery (TSD) and Train Punctuality (TP), which were introduced in the previous report to provide commuters with a more comprehensive view of our rail network\u2019s performance over time. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Train Service Adjustments to Circle Line for Tunnel Works
item.description: From 17 January to 19 April 2026, the two tunnels connecting Mountbatten, Dakota and Paya Lebar stations on the Circle Line (CCL) will be closed one at a time for essential tunnel strengthening works (refer to Annex A for further information on the tunnel strengthening works). During this period, shuttle trains will operate on one platform, between Paya Lebar and Mountbatten stations at headways of 10 minutes using the tunnel that remains open. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Refund of Road Tax Collected for Diesel and Diesel-Hybrid Goods-Cum-Passengers Vehicles
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be issuing refunds to around 1,700 owners of diesel and diesel-hybrid goods-cum-passengers vehicles (GPVs) for road tax collected between 1 August 2022 and 30 November 2025. This refund exercise is being conducted to address a discrepancy between the road tax rates collected and those stipulated in the relevant legislation during the specified period. For more information, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Reminder on Train Service Adjustments along East-West Line from 29 November to 8 December 2025 to Facilitate Track Connection to the East Coast Integrated Depot and Operationalise New Platform at Tanah Merah MRT station
item.description: Commuters are reminded that from 29 November to 8 December 2025, LTA and SMRT are undertaking construction works to connect the tracks from the existing East-West Line (EWL) to the East Coast Integrated Depot (ECID) and to connect a new platform at Tanah Merah station. During this period, train services on the East-West Line between Bedok and Tampines stations and between Tanah Merah to Expo stations will be affected. With the closure of Simei and Tanah Merah MRT stations from 29 November to 8 December, there will be no train service between Bedok and Tampines stations, and between Tanah Merah and Expo stations. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SBS Transit & SMRT - Independent Advisory Panel on Rail Reliability Visits Singapore
item.description: To strengthen Singapore\u2019s rail network and reliability, the Rail Reliability Taskforce established a five-member Independent Advisory Panel to provide strategic guidance and technical expertise. The five Panel members are in Singapore from 17 to 21 November 2025 for consultations with the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and local rail operators SMRT and SBS Transit. Please refer to the attached press release for more information.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates from 24 November 2025
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Public Consultation Launched to Refresh Land Transport Master Plan
item.description: Acting Minister for Transport and Senior Minister of State for Finance Mr Jeffrey Siow has announced the launch of the nationwide public consultation to co-create Singapore\u2019s refreshed Land Transport Master Plan (LTMP). This long-term strategic blueprint will chart the next phase of Singapore\u2019s land transport system, with consultations taking place over the coming year and the refreshed Master Plan targeted for release in 2027. Please refer to the media materials attached for more information.

item.title: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & PTC - Celebrating 5 Years of Caring Commuter Week: Championing Caring Commuter Culture and Honouring Caring Commuters
item.description: On 15 November 2025, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and Public Transport Council (PTC) launched the fifth edition of Caring Commuter Week 2025, marking five years of collective commitment to fostering a gracious, caring and inclusive commuting culture. Held in support of the Caring SG Commuters Movement, this year\u2019s Caring Commuter Week features a line-up of activities to honour commuters who have demonstrated exceptional care towards others during their public transport journeys. Please refer to the media materials attached for more information.

item.title: Factsheet: LTA’s Move Lite Campaign: Hello Kitty’s Move Lite Adventure Now Open for Play
item.description: The campaign encourages participants to adopt more environmentally friendly ways of getting around, such as taking public transport and walking, to discover the fun and rewards of these choices. Participants can take part in a series of interactive activities to earn coins and badges, and unlock exclusive Hello Kitty\u2019s merchandise. Please refer to the factsheet attached for more information.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for November 2025 to January 2026
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for November 2025 to January 2026 will be 18,984. Overall, the COE quota for November 2025 to January 2026 is 1.5% higher than the last quarter (August 2025 to October 2025). For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Marks 30th Anniversary with Expanded Art in Transit
item.description: In celebration of the Land Transport Authority (LTA)\u2019s 30th anniversary, LTA is expanding the Art in Transit (AIT) programme to bring more vibrancy to MRT stations and enrich commuters\u2019 daily journeys. The expansion includes three key initiatives, the extension of the AIT programme, a new partnership with Bloomberg Connects showcasing AIT installations through an interactive digital guide, and a specially commissioned artwork at Little India station to commemorate LTA\u2019s 30th anniversary. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: 10.8km of Cycling Paths in Toa Payoh Completed
item.description: The newly completed cycling paths in Toa Payoh now connect residents to Singapore\'s expanding cycling network, making it even easier to navigate within and beyond their town using active mobility options. The cycling paths, spanning around 10.8km, were launched by Mr Cai Yinzhou, Grassroots Adviser to Bishan-Toa Payoh GRO, today. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: Free Morning Off-Peak Rail Rides
item.description: To moderate travel demand during the morning peak and improve the experience for commuters, rides on the North East Line (NEL) and Sengkang-Punggol LRT (SPLRT) taken before and after peak hours (before 7.30am, and between 9.00am and 9.45am) will be free. We will also simplify the enrolment for the Travel Smart Journeys (TSJ) programme and increase the rewards to commuters. Commuters can benefit from one or both of these schemes from 27 December 2025. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: More Service Improvements Under the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme
item.description: Since its launch in July 2024, the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme (BCEP) has brought commuters more travel options and shorter journeys, benefitting close to 200,000 commuters daily. The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has introduced 14 bus services in estates across the island, providing residents with easier access to the rail network and key amenities. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Introducing Monthly Rail Reliability Reports
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will publish monthly updates on rail reliability data, instead of on a quarterly basis. This revised monthly cadence is part of our ongoing efforts to improve transparency and accountability, and to provide the public with a clearer picture of how our rail network has been performing over time. For more details, please refer to the attached news release and the rail service reliability performance for the period Sep 2024-August 2025.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SMRT & SBS Transit - Rail Reliability Taskforce Appoints Independent Advisory Panel
item.description: The Rail Reliability Taskforce has appointed a five-member Independent Advisory Panel (IAP) to provide strategic guidance, technical expertise and insights to support the Taskforce\u2019s efforts in enhancing Singapore\'s rail network reliability. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Train Service Adjustments Along East-West Line from 29 November to 8 December 2025 to Facilitate Track Connection to the East Coast Integrated Depot and Operationalise New Platform at Tanah Merah MRT Station
item.description: To prepare for the opening of the new East Coast Integrated Depot (ECID) in 2026, LTA and SMRT are undertaking construction works to connect the tracks from the existing East-West Line (EWL) to the Depot and to connect a new platform at Tanah Merah station. These works will be carried out over ten days from 29 November to 8 December 2025. During this period, train services on the East-West Line between Bedok and Tampines stations and between Tanah Merah to Expo stations will be affected. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Contract for the Pilot Deployment of Autonomous Buses on Two Public Bus Services
item.description: As part of the Ministry of Transport (MOT) and the Land Transport Authority (LTA)\u2019s plans to pilot the use of Autonomous Vehicle (AV) technology, LTA has awarded a contract to a consortium of MKX Technologies Pte Ltd, Zhidao Network Technology (Beijing) Co. Ltd and BYD (Singapore) Pte Ltd for a contract sum of around $8.14 million to pilot autonomous buses. Please refer to the news release attached for more details.

item.title: Reminder on Traffic Arrangements for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2025
item.description: The public is reminded of the road closures around the Marina Centre and Padang area from 1 to 7 October 2025 to facilitate preparations for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2025. Affected roads will be progressively closed from 12.01am, 1 October 2025. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: New Autonomous Shuttle Services to be Progressively Deployed in Punggol
item.description: Three scheduled fixed-route autonomous shuttle services will be progressively deployed in Punggol to enhance first-mile-last-mile (FMLM) connectivity. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: LTA and Rail Operators Establish Rail Reliability Taskforce to Address Service Disruptions
item.description: The Land Transport Authority and rail operators SMRT and SBS Transit will form a Rail Reliability Taskforce. Please refer to the attached press release for more details.

item.title: LTA Awards Tampines Bus Package to Go-Ahead Singapore
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the contract for the Tampines Bus Package to The Go-Ahead Group (GAS) today. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: 51 Organisations Recognised for Workplace Safety, Health and Environmental Excellence
item.description: 51 organisations have been recognised by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) for their outstanding workplace safety, health and environmental management practices at the 27th Annual Safety, Health and Environmental Awards Convention (ASAC) held today (16 September 2025) at Singapore Expo Max Atria. For more information, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: All New Motorcycles Registered from 1 April 2027 to Have Anti-Lock Braking System
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be enhancing safety standards for motorcycles in Singapore as part of our ongoing efforts to improve vehicle and road safety. Following industry consultations, LTA will require all newly registered motorcycles to be equipped with Anti-lock Braking System (ABS) from 1 April 2027. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & NEA - Extension of Vehicular Emissions Scheme (VES) and EV Early Adoption Incentive (EEAI) to Support Vehicle Electrification
item.description: To support Singapore\u2019s vision of 100% cleaner-energy vehicles by 2040, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the National Environment Agency (NEA) will extend the Vehicular Emissions Scheme (VES) from 1 January 2026 to 31 December 2027, with revisions to its banding, rebates and surcharges. The Electric Vehicle (EV) Early Adoption Incentive (EEAI) will be extended until 31 December 2026 and be ceased from 1 January 2027. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Road Closure and Public Transport Arrangement for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2025
item.description: The Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2025 will be held from 3 to 5 October 2025 around the Marina Centre and Padang area. To facilitate set-up and removal of race infrastructure, road closures in the Marina Centre and Padang area will take place over seven days, from 1 to 7 October 2025. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates from 1 September 2025
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Making Bus Journeys Safer for Everyone
item.description: The inaugural Bus Safety Roadshow will take place at Toa Payoh HDB Hub atrium on 23 and 24 August 2025. The roadshow is one of the Bus Safety Tripartite Taskforce\u2019s (BSTT) recommendations to raise awareness and promote public bus safety among commuters and road users. Please refer to the attached media release for more details on the roadshow and updates on the Bus Safety Tripartite Taskforce initiatives.

item.title: Recognising Safety and Security Efforts in the Public Transport Sector
item.description: The fourth edition of the Public Transport Safety and Security Awards (PTSSA) was held today to recognise public transport workers and operators for their contributions in keeping our public transport network safe and secure. About 450 award winners and representatives from the public transport sector attended the event. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Factsheet: World Car-Free Day 2025: Refresh Your Journey This September
item.description: This September, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) is leading a month-long celebration of sustainable mobility in conjunction with World Car-Free Day 2025. This collaborative initiative brings together various government agencies, organisations and Public Transport Operators (PTOs) to organise car-free activities for the public. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Joint Media Statement by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SBS Transit on the Recent North East Line and Sengkang-Punggol LRT Disruptions
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and SBS Transit (SBST) would like to provide an update on our investigations into the power fault incidents along the North East Line (NEL) and Sengkang-Punggol LRT (SPLRT) on 12 and 15 August 2025. The Sengkang Depot Substation has two interconnected switchboards (see diagram) which serve as backups for each other.\nFor additional details, please refer to the attached media statement.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Circle Line Stage 6 Moves to Next Phase of Works Ahead of Opening in 1H2026
item.description: In preparation for the opening of the Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) in the first half of 2026, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and SMRT have successfully completed the installation of new Integrated Supervisory Control System (ISCS) for the Circle Line (CCL) in July. LTA and SMRT are now moving into the next phase of works to carry out systems integration testing across the entire CCL. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Media Statement on Clarification on Cross-Border Point-to-Point Transport Arrangements
item.description: We note recent Malaysian media reports suggesting that Singapore is looking to introduce cross-border on-demand ride services. We would like to clarify the current arrangements and ongoing discussions. On 1 Aug 2025, Singapore and Malaysian officials met to discuss cross-border service arrangements. For additional details, please refer to the attached media statement.

item.title: Bukit Panjang LRT: Signalling System and Fleet Renewal Nears Completion, Station Lifts to be Upgraded
item.description: There will be two upcoming full day closures for the BPLRT as part of signalling system renewal works. At the same time, passenger lifts at all BPLRT stations will also be upgraded. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for August 2025 to October 2025
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for August 2025 to October 2025 will be 18,701. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Thomson-East Coast Line Extension and Cross Island Line: Connecting Changi Airport Directly to the City Centre and Major Hubs
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) announced a new TEL \u2013 CRL interchange station \u2013 TE32\/CR1 Changi Terminal 5 \u2013 that will connect the upcoming Changi Airport Terminal 5 directly to the city centre and other major hubs through the Thomson \u2013 East Coast Line extension (TELe) and Cross Island Line (CRL). For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Media Statement on Imposition of Financial Penalty on SMRT
item.description: LTA notified SMRT of its intention to impose a financial penalty of $3 million for the 25 September 2024 East-West Line Incident (\u201CNotice of Intention\u201D) on 30 May 2025, and provided two weeks for SMRT to submit its representations. For additional details, please refer to the attached media statement.

item.title: First Two New Two-Car Sengkang-Punggol Light Rail Vehicles to Commence Passenger Service from 15 July 2025
item.description: The first two of 25 new third-generation two-car Light Rail Vehicles (LRVs) for the Sengkang-Punggol LRT (SPLRT) will begin passenger service on 15 July 2025. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Construction Begins on Cross Island Line Phase 2
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has commenced civil construction works for Phase 2 of the Cross Island Line (CRL). Acting Minister for Transport Jeffrey Siow officiated the ground-breaking ceremony at the site of the future CRL Clementi station. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Start of Enforcement on Newly Converted Pedestrian-Only Paths from 1 July 2025
item.description: From 1 July 2025, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will start enforcement actions against those riding on footpaths that have been converted to Pedestrian-Only Paths, for the safety of more vulnerable pedestrians such as seniors and children. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Completes Investigation into the Cause of East-West Line Service Disruption in September 2024
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its investigations into the root cause of the train service disruption on the East-West Line (EWL) between Jurong East and Buona Vista stations that occurred from 25 to 30 September 2024. For more details, refer to the attached news release and report.\n

item.title: Opening of Realigned Lim Chu Kang Road from 8 June 2025
item.description: To facilitate the expansion of Tengah Air Base, the realigned Lim Chu Kang Road will open on 8 June 2025 at 12.30am. Spanning about eight kilometres, the realigned road will comprise a dual 3-lane carriageway from Jalan Bahar to the new junction with Old Choa Chu Kang Road and the realigned Lim Chu Kang Road, before transitioning into a dual 2-lane carriageway. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Service Adjustments on the Circle Line in preparation for Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) Opening
item.description: To prepare for the opening of the Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) in the first half of 2026, which will close the loop for the Circle Line by connecting HarbourFront station to Marina Bay station, LTA and SMRT will carry out a series of works on the existing CCL to renew its Integrated Supervisory Control System (ISCS). This is to ensure system compatibility with the new stretch of the Circle Line. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates for June 2025 School Holiday Period
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Punggol Coast Bus Interchange to Open on 29 June 2025
item.description: Commuters in north-east Singapore can look forward to greater connectivity with the opening of Punggol Coast Bus Interchange (BI) on 29 June 2025. Located within Punggol Digital District, the BI is integrated with Punggol Coast MRT station on the North East Line and Punggol Coast Mall. Operated by Go-Ahead Singapore, it will be the 15th Integrated Transport Hub in Singapore. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Appoints Moove Media as Advertising Operator for Buses and Bus Interchanges
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded Moove Media Pte. Ltd. (\u201CMoove Media\u201D) the contract to manage advertising spaces on public buses and at bus interchanges. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & American Express - Public Transport Commuters Can Use American Express Contactless Cards for Transit Payment from 15 May 2025
item.description: From 15 May 2025, commuters will be able to use their American Express cards to make contactless payments for public transport fares. This will provide greater convenience and choice for public transport commuters. Please refer to the joint news release attached for more details.

item.title: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & URA - New Measures Slated to Improve Last-Mile Deliveries
item.description: The Tripartite Workgroup co-led by the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) and Land Transport Authority (LTA) will progressively implement more measures this year to improve the efficiency of last-mile deliveries, enhance the safety of e-commerce platform workers as well as minimise disamenities caused by delivery pick-ups and drop-offs. These measures directly address key challenges identified by delivery stakeholders through engagements led by the Workgroup since its formation in November 2023. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for May 2025 to July 2025
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for May 2025 to July 2025 will be 18,232. Compared to the last quarter, COE quota increased by 10% for Category A, 5% each for Categories B and C, and 3% for Category D. On a year-on-year basis, it is a 21% increase in total COE quota. Bidding under this quota will start on 5 May 2025. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: More Improvements Under the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme in 2025
item.description: Since the launch of the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme (BCEP) in July 2024, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has introduced 11 bus services to improve connectivity to estates across the island such as Woodlands, Punggol and Tengah. 43 existing services have also been enhanced with additional capacity or expanded coverage. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: Two New Bus Interchanges to Open in April 2025
item.description: Commuters can look forward to the opening of the new Woodleigh and Pasir Ris Bus Interchanges on 20 and 27 April 2025 respectively. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: GrabCab Pte Ltd Awarded Street-Hail Service Operator Licence, More Choices for Drivers and Commuters
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded a Street-hail Service Operator Licence (SSOL) to GrabCab Pte Ltd (\u201CGrabCab\u201D), a subsidiary of Grab Rentals Pte Ltd, and sister company of GrabCar Pte Ltd, which holds a Ride-hail Service Operator Licence (RSOL) and a Car-pool Service Operator Licence (CSOL). Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: Singapore Rail Test Centre Opens for Operations
