item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) today announced the completion of the Singapore Rail Test Centre (SRTC) in Tuas, which occupies a site of approximately 50 hectares. Fully equipped to conduct rigorous testing and commissioning of trains and core railways systems, the SRTC will support testing requirements for both new and existing rail lines. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: Phase 2 of Point-to-Point Transport Industry Structure and Regulatory Framework Review
item.description: As announced at the Ministry of Transport\u2019s Committee of Supply 2025, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be implementing several measures to improve the stability, contestability and inclusivity of the point-to-point transport (P2P) industry. Please refer to the news release for more information.

item.title: Expanding our Rail Network and Strengthening Rail Reliability and Resilience
item.description: Singapore\u2019s rail network is set to expand as announced at the Ministry of Transport\u2019s Committee of Supply debate today. LTA plans to proceed with the West Coast Extension which extends the Jurong Region Line to connect with the Circle Line and Cross Island Line. Feasibility studies are also ongoing for new rail lines to further improve access to public transport. Concurrent with these expansion efforts, additional investments will be made to support tripartite efforts to maintain the reliability of our existing rail network. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & MHA - Friendlier and Safer Walk Cycle Ride Journeys
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is continuing efforts to enhance road safety and inclusivity in Singapore to encourage walking, cycling and taking public transport. First, LTA will expand the Friendly Streets initiative to 15 more locations. Second, to ensure that our roads are safer for young children, we will extend the lower speed limit of 40km\/h along School Zones near primary schools to apply throughout the entire day, instead of only at specific hours. Third, we will embark on three new road repurposing projects to create more seamless connections to amenities, and safer pedestrian zones. Please refer to the news release attached for more information.

item.title: Strengthening Singapore’s Electric Vehicle Ecosystem to Reduce Land Transport Emissions
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is pressing on with our vehicle electrification efforts. To support decarbonisation of heavy vehicles, LTA will introduce the Heavy Vehicle Zero Emissions Scheme (HVZES) and Electric Heavy Vehicle Charger Grant (EHVCG). These initiatives aim to narrow the gap in ownership cost between an electric heavy vehicle (eHV) and an ICE heavy vehicle, and to support the deployment of eHV chargers in Singapore. In addition, LTA will extend and expand the EV Common Charger Grant (ECCG) to further encourage charger deployment at non-landed private residences (NLPRs), such as condominiums, and keep pace with EV adoption. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint Tripartite Statement by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), MOT, DPIA & NDCA - New Rules on Personal Mobility Aids
item.description: The new rules on Personal Mobility Aids (PMAs), including the reduced speed limit and new device dimensions, will make paths safer for all users. The rules are designed to curb misuse by able-bodied users, and reserve the use of mobility scooters to users with mobility challenges. Able-bodied users have alternatives such as bicycles or power-assisted bicycles. Please refer to the statement attached for more information.

item.title: A Better Commuting Experience for All
item.description: As announced at the Ministry of Transport\u2019s Committee of Supply debate today, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will step up enforcement against nuisance and disruptive commuter behaviour on our public transport. This is intended to create a more pleasant commuting experience for the majority of commuters who are considerate and gracious to others. For more details, please refer to the news release.\n

item.title: Three-Year Lock-In Period for Business-Owned Chauffeured Private Hire Cars to Enhance Stability of the Point-to-Point Transport Supply
item.description: To achieve a more stable supply of vehicles that can be used to provide ride-hail services, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will introduce a mandatory three-year lock-in period for all newly registered or converted chauffeured Private Hire Cars (cPHCs) owned by businesses, and all cPHCs transferred from individuals to businesses. Please refer to the news release for more information.\n

item.title: LTA Media Statement on Recent Train Incidents
item.description: LTA takes a serious view of the recent incidents on the North-South Line, North East Line and Circle Line, and is working closely with SMRT and SBS Transit to identify the root causes and improve our incident response. For additional details, please refer to the attached media statement.

item.title: Request for Proposals for the Pilot Deployment of Autonomous Buses for Public Bus Services
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has launched a Request for Proposal (RFP) today to seek industry\u2019s proposals to pilot autonomous public bus services. Through this pilot, LTA aims to assess the technical feasibility of autonomous vehicle (AV) technology for public bus services, and gain insights into the operational aspects of running autonomous buses at both service and fleet levels. Please refer to the news release attached for more details.\n

item.title: Hume Station to Open on 28 February 2025
item.description: The new Hume MRT station on the Downtown Line (DTL) will open for passenger service at 3pm on 28 February 2025. Hume station is located along Upper Bukit Timah Road, between Hillview and Beauty World stations. It will serve existing residential developments along Hume Avenue and provide Singaporeans with even more convenient access to the Rail Corridor (Central) and Former Ford Factory. Please refer to the news release for more details.\n

item.title: Retailer to be Charged for Selling Non-Compliant Power-Assisted Bicycle (PAB)
item.description: A retailer will be charged in relation to fire incidents involving non-compliant active mobility devices (AMDs). Sales & Marketing Manager of Drive Bikes Singapore, Mr Prince Bryan Tan, will be charged in court on 23 January 2025 for selling a non-compliant Power-Assisted Bicycle (PAB) and causing a PAB to be modified, rendering it non-compliant for use under the Active Mobility Act 2017 and Road Traffic Act 1961, respectively. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.\n

item.title: National Arts Council and Land Transport Authority Partner to Unveil ‘A Living Museum For Bukit Gombak’ at The Under Viaduct Space, Celebrating SG60 With Art at Unconventional Spaces During Singapore Art Week 2025
item.description: Singapore, 17 January 2025 \u2013 As part of Singapore Art Week (SAW) 2025, the National Arts Council (NAC) and Land Transport Authority (LTA) announced the launch of art under viaduct spaces, a new project born from a three-year Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed in January 2024. This inaugural project by NAC and LTA, supported by SMRT and the People\u2019s Association (PA), reimagines public transport spaces as canvases for the arts, invites the public to encounter art in familiar yet unconventional spaces, and transforms daily commutes into enriching cultural experiences. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for February 2025 to April 2025
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for February 2025 to April 2025 will be 17,133. Overall, the COE quota for February 2025 to April 2025 is 8% higher than last quarter (November 2024 to January 2025) and 16% higher than the same quarter last year (February 2024 to April 2024). Compared to the last quarter, the COE quota for Categories A, B, C and E increased by about 10% whilst Category D quota remained unchanged. Bidding under this quota will start on 3 February 2025. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.\n

item.title: Ten New Friendly Streets by 2026
item.description: Today, Senior Minister of State for Transport Dr Amy Khor announced the locations of 10 new Friendly Streets sites islandwide. Friendly Streets are located in residential areas with high pedestrian activity and close to key amenities such as markets, hawker centres, community clubs, schools, and MRT stations. In partnership with the local communities, the locations and features of the 10 new Friendly Streets were finalised after consultation with stakeholders and residents. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more details.

item.title: Three New Stations to Connect Downtown Line to North-South Line
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is pleased to announce the alignment and station locations for the Downtown Line 2 extension (DTL2e). DTL2e will connect the Downtown Line (DTL) from its existing terminus at Bukit Panjang station to a new NS6\/DE2 interchange station on the North-South Line (NSL). Please refer to the news release for more details.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & NEA -Commercial Vehicle Emissions Scheme and Early Turnover Scheme Extended
item.description: To continue encouraging the adoption of cleaner commercial vehicles, incentives for vehicles in Band A under the Commercial Vehicle Emissions Scheme (CVES) will be extended for two years from 1 April 2025 till 31 March 2027. The Early Turnover Scheme (ETS) will be extended for Heavy Commercial Vehicles (HCVs) till 31 December 2025. For more information, please refer to the attached release.

item.title: Award of Operator Licences and Implementation of Phase 1 of the Point-to-Point Transport Regulatory Framework Review
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed the evaluation of point-to-point transport (P2P) operators\u2019 licence renewals and applications. All existing licensees will have their respective licences renewed, and two new ride-hail operators will be awarded one-year provisional licences. The licensing conditions have been updated to incorporate new regulatory requirements announced as part of the first phase of the P2P industry structure and regulatory framework review. For more details, refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Travel Smart Journeys Gets a Boost: New Rewards and Expanded Options for Commuters
item.description: From 2 January 2025, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will enhance the Travel Smart Journeys (TSJ) initiative to provide enhanced incentives and include more eligible bus options. For the first time, the initiative will also provide incentives to commuters who shift their commutes outside the morning peak period. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Punggol Coast Station Welcomes Commuters from 10 December 2024
item.description: The Punggol Coast station on the North East Line (NEL), located in the heart of Punggol Digital District (PDD), will open for passenger service at 3.00pm today. Earlier this morning, Senior Minister and Coordinating Minister for National Security Teo Chee Hean, Minister for Transport Chee Hong Tat and Grassroots Advisers from the Pasir Ris - Punggol Group Representation Constituency attended the ceremony to mark the opening of the station. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Growing Singapore’s Bus Network with the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme
item.description: Since the launch of the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme (BCEP) in July 2024, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has made improvements to 29 existing services and introduced new bus services to improve connectivity to estates such as Punggol, Tengah, Tampines and Yishun. These improvements were made following reviews of the bus network, ridership and areas of growing demand. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Reminder on Train Service Adjustments along East-West Line from 7 to 10 December 2024 to Facilitate Connection to New East Coast Integrated Depot
item.description: Commuters are reminded that LTA and SMRT will be undertaking a series of works to facilitate the connection of tracks from the existing East-West Line (EWL) to the ECID to prepare for the opening of the new East Coast Integrated Depot (ECID) in 2026. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Singaporean Man Fined $1.5 Million for Coordinating Scheme to Evade Duty And GST on Imported Motor Vehicles
item.description: Singapore, 2 December 2024 \u2013 On 2 December 2024, Liang Huan Shuo, Jason (\u6881\u6853\u7855) (\u201CLiang\u201D), 44, the sole proprietor of JDM Automobile (\u201CAutomobile\u201D) and partner of Autogallery@JDM (\u201CAutogallery\u201D), was sentenced by the State Courts to a fine of $1.5 million for fraudulent evasion of duty and Goods and Services Tax (GST) on 427 motor vehicles imported into Singapore between January 2019 and October 2020. He was also sentenced to an additional five weeks\u2019 imprisonment for underpaying the Additional Registration Fee (ARF) during the registration of the vehicles. Please refer to the attached press release for more details.

item.title: Recognising Technical Skills and Driving Innovation Across the Public Bus and Rail Industry
item.description: The Singapore BusTech Grand Challenge (SGBTGC) took place today in conjunction with the Singapore RailTech Grand Challenge (SGRTGC). Please refer to the attached press release for more details.

item.title: Installation of Rail Systems for the Johor Bahru – Singapore Rapid Transit System Link Project to Begin by end-2024; Completion of the Viaduct Aesthetic Feature
item.description: The Johor Bahru \u2013 Singapore Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link Project between Singapore and Malaysia is reaching another significant milestone. The Infrastructure Companies (InfraCos) of Malaysia and Singapore will grant RTS Operations Pte Ltd (RTSO) access to the RTS Link civil structures progressively by the end of this year. This will allow RTSO to commence the installation works for the RTS Link rail systems. Please refer to the joint news release attached in this email for more details.

item.title: Jurong Region Line Operations Awarded to Joint Venture Between SBS Transit Rail and RATP Dev Asia Pacific
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the contract to operate the Jurong Region Line to a joint venture between SBS Transit Rail and RATP Dev Asia Pacific (SRJV). The operator for the Cross Island Line will be selected at a later date. Please refer to the attached media release for more details.

item.title: ERP Rates for the December 2024 School Holiday Period
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), PTC & Caring SG Commuters Committee - Celebrating Our Commuters Who Go Above and Beyond
item.description: The Caring Commuter Week 2024 (CCW), organised by the Caring SG Commuters Committee, Land Transport Authority (LTA), and Public Transport Council (PTC), marks the culmination of a series of activities and events this year aimed at fostering a caring commuter culture on public transport. Now in its fourth year, CCW also honours commuters who have demonstrated exceptional acts of care to others during their public transport journeys. Mr Chee Hong Tat, Minister for Transport and Second Minister for Finance, launched the CCW at Bedok Town Square today. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Train Service Adjustments Along East-West Line from 7 to 10 December 2024 to Facilitate Connection to New East Coast Integrated Depot
item.description: To prepare for the opening of the new East Coast Integrated Depot (ECID) in 2026, LTA and SMRT will be undertaking a series of works to facilitate the connection of tracks from the existing East-West Line (EWL) to the ECID. These works will take place over four days from 7 to 10 December 2024. During this period, there will be no train service on the EWL between Tanah Merah and Tampines stations. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: New Buangkok Bus Interchange to Start Operations on 1 December 2024
item.description: Commuters in the north-eastern region can look forward to more convenient transfers and better connectivity with the opening of Buangkok Bus Interchange (BI) on Sunday, 1 December 2024. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.\n

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Service Adjustments for Bukit Panjang LRT from 14 November 2024 to 31 October 2025 to Support Renewal Works
item.description: Train services on the Bukit Panjang LRT will end one hour earlier at 10.30pm every Thursday to Sunday, from 14 November 2024 till 31 October 2025 (except on public holidays). This is to facilitate upgrading of the BPLRT signalling system, as well as the testing of new and retrofitted Light Rail Vehicles. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Promoting Safe Path Sharing from An Early Age
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has partnered PCF Sparkletots to co-create a children\u2019s storybook titled \u2018Rico & His Glowie \u2013 A Book About Sharing Paths\u2019. This collaboration aims to foster safe and responsible path-sharing behaviours among young children aged between three to six. It is part of LTA\u2019s ongoing efforts to promote responsible path use among path users. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Injection of Additional COE Quota with Reduced Usage & ERP 2.0 Transition
item.description: Given the recent reduced vehicle usage trend and improved congestion management capabilities of ERP2.0, LTA will progressively inject up to about 20,000 additional COEs across the vehicle categories from February 2025, over the next few years. LTA has also streamlined the booking process to allow for a more efficient on-board unit (OBU) installation experience for vehicle owners. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & the International Association of Public Transport (UITP) - Smarter Journeys for Sustainable Cities
item.description: The 5th edition of the Singapore International Transport Congress and Exhibition (SITCE) will be held from 6 \u2013 8 November 2024 at the Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre. The theme for this year\u2019s event is \u2018Smarter Journeys for Sustainable Cities.\u2019 Over the three-day event, more than 100 experts and moderators will present and discuss strategies, innovations and technologies that address challenges in the land transport industry as well as the future of urban mobility. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: New Electric Bus Features for Safer and Inclusive Journeys
item.description: Ten more electric buses will commence passenger service from December 2024. They will be deployed on bus services 86, 107 and 159, and use the charging infrastructure at the new Sengkang West Bus Depot. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Celebrating a Decade of Thoughtfulness
item.description: The Land Transport Authority\u2019s (LTA) Graciousness on Public Transport Campaign encourages thoughtful acts and behaviours such as giving up seats, queuing in an orderly manner, and moving in for a more pleasant commute on public transport. Introduced in 2014, the Thoughtful Bunch - Stand-up Stacey, Move-In Martin, Give-Way Glenda, Bag-Down Benny and Hush-Hush Hannah \u2013 serve as ambassadors for these behaviours. This year marks the 10th year anniversary of our Thoughtful Bunch, which will be celebrated with a series of special initiatives and activities. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Punggol Coast Station to Open for Passenger Service from 10 December 2024
item.description: Punggol Coast station on the North East Line (NEL) will open for passenger service at 3.00pm on Tuesday, 10 December 2024. The new station, an extension from the existing Punggol station, will be the new terminal station on the NEL. Please refer to the news release attached in this email.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for November 2024 to January 2025
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for November 2024 to January 2025 will be 15,834. Overall, the COE quota for November 2024 to January 2025 is 4% higher than last quarter (August 2024 to October 2024). Compared to the last quarter, the COE quota increased 6% for Category A, 2% for Category B and 8% for Category C, whilst Category D quota remained unchanged. Bidding under this quota will start on 4 November 2024. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA to Conduct Thorough Investigations Into the Root Cause of the Disruption of Services on East-West Line
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has commenced regulatory investigations into the disruption of train services on the East-West Line between Jurong East and Buona Vista stations from 25 to 30 September 2024. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: 50 Organisations Recognised for Workplace Safety, Health and Environmental Excellence
item.description: Fifty organisations have been recognised by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) for their outstanding workplace safety, health and environmental management practices at the 26th Annual Safety, Health and Environmental Awards Convention (ASAC). Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Full Resumption of Service on East-West Line on 1 October 2024
item.description: Full train services on the East-West Line (EWL) will resume on Tuesday, 1 October 2024 from the start of passenger service hours. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - More Time Needed for Thorough Testing to Ensure Commuter Safety
item.description: There will be no train services from Jurong East to Buona Vista stations on 30 September. We are working towards restoration of train services on Tuesday, 1 October, subject to weather conditions and after thorough testing have been successfully completed to ensure safety of commuters. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Update on East-West Line Recovery Works
item.description: LTA and SMRT engineers have worked through the night, and found extensive damage to the track and trackside equipment. Investigations revealed that a defective train axle box on the train dropped, causing one bogie to come off the running rail between Dover and Clementi stations. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - No Train Service on the East-West Line from Jurong East to Buona Vista on 27 September
item.description: There will be no train service on the East-West Line (EWL) between Jurong East and Buona Vista stations on 27 September 2024. Please see attached for the joint LTA-SMRT news release for more details.

item.title: No Train Service on the East-West Line from Jurong East to Buona Vista on 26 Sep
item.description: There will be no train service on the East-West Line (EWL) between Jurong East and Buona Vista stations on 26 September 2024. LTA and SMRT engineers commenced recovery works since the afternoon after the rains stopped and will continue into the night. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & NEA - Sustained Government Support for Singapore’s Transition to Cleaner Energy Vehicles
item.description: To support the vision of 100% cleaner energy vehicles by 2040, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the National Environment Agency (NEA) will continue to incentivise the adoption of cleaner energy vehicles from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2025, with an emphasis on electric vehicles. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SCDF - Be Device-Safe Programme 2024
item.description: The Active Mobility Fire Safety Taskforce co-chaired by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) and the Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) first launched the Be Device-Safe Programme in 2023. The programme aims to educate users of motorised Active Mobility Devices (AMDs) such as Personal Mobility Devices (PMDs) or Power-Assisted Bicycles (PABs) about the risk of AMD-related fires and how to safely use and maintain these devices. This year, LTA and SCDF jointly unveiled the programme\u2019s new visual during the Sembawang West Community Resilience Day at Woodlands Mart, which was observed by Advisor for Sembawang West, Ms Poh Li San. For more details, kindly refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Reminder on Traffic Arrangements for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2024
item.description: The public is reminded of the road closures around the Marina Centre and Padang area from 18 to 24 September 2024 to facilitate preparations for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2024. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Two Civil Contracts for Changi Northern And Southern Corridors
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded two civil contracts for the enhancement of a section of Loyang Avenue, Telok Paku Road, Nicoll Drive and Changi Coast Road at the Changi Northern Corridor, as well as the enhancement of road networks at the Pan Island Expressway (PIE), East Coast Parkway (ECP) and Changi Flyover at the Changi Southern Corridor to Samwoh Corporation Pte. Ltd. (SWC). For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Voluntary Conversion to SimplyGo for MOE School Smart Cards to Commence from 7 September 2024
item.description: Starting from 7 September 2024, Ministry of Education Primary, Secondary and Junior College\/Millennia Institute students can choose to convert their student concession card (or School Smart Cards (SSC)) to a SimplyGo SSC. This comes after feedback from parents and students that they would like to have the option of converting their existing SSC to a SimplyGo SSC, to make it more convenient for parents to top up their children\u2019s cards remotely via the SimplyGo app. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates from 9 September 2024
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: ERP Administrative Charge to be Waived for Payments Settled within Five-Day Grace Period
item.description: Leveraging technology is a key aspect of the Government\u2019s transformation efforts, creating opportunities to review and refine rules and processes to better serve citizens and businesses. One such area of review is to simplify the payment process when a motorist misses an Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) charge. For more details, kindly refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Master Plan Consultant Appointed for North-South Corridor’s Surface Streets
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) announced today the appointment of Henning Larsen and partners as the Master Plan Consultant for the surface streets along the North-South Corridor (NSC). Henning Larsen\u2019s proposal, themed Singapore\u2019s Life Reserve \u2013 a Place for All, outlines the vision and design strategies that will integrate active mobility, placemaking and greenery through people-centric spaces and experiences along the 21.5km Corridor. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release. \n

item.title: Road Closure and Public Transport Arrangement for the Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2024
item.description: The Formula 1 Singapore Airlines Singapore Grand Prix 2024 will be held from 20 to 22 September 2024 around the Marina Centre and Padang area. As with previous editions, road closures will be required to facilitate event preparations. Road closures in the Marina Centre and Padang area will take place over seven days, from 18 to 24 September 2024. Members of the public and F1 ticket holders are strongly encouraged to take public transport during this period. Please refer to the attached news release for more information.\n

item.title: Cycling Paths Connecting Choa Chu Kang and Yew Tee Towns Completed
item.description: Cycling connectivity in the West has been further enhanced with the completion of the Choa Chu Kang-Yew Tee cycling path network. The cycling paths spanning around 11km were launched by Mr Gan Kim Yong, Deputy Prime Minister, Minister for Trade and Industry and Grassroots Adviser to Chua Chu Kang GRC Grassroots Organisations today. Please refer to the attached news release for more information.\n

item.title: Recognising Safety and Security Efforts in the Public Transport Sector
item.description: The Public Transport Safety and Security Awards (PTSSA) was held today to recognise PT workers and operators for their efforts to ensure safety and security across our public transport network. Mr Murali Pillai, Minister of State for Law and Transport, attended the event with close to 400 award winners and representatives from the public transport sector. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Go on a Car-Free Adventure This September
item.description: In conjunction with World Car-Free Day, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) in partnership with Health Promotion Board (HPB), Housing and Development Board (HDB), National Heritage Board (NHB), JTC Corporation (JTC), National Parks Board (NParks), Singapore Art Museum (SAM), Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), and public transport operators (PTOs), SBST and SMRT, is organising a month-long series of car-free activities for the public this September. Please refer to the factsheet attached in this email for more information.\n

item.title: Enhancements to Seven Bus Interchanges to Start in August 2024
item.description: To enhance the commuting experience and create a more family-friendly and inclusive public transport system, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will carry out enhancement works in seven bus interchanges (BIs) from August 2024. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.\n

item.title: Final Civil Contract for Cross Island Line Phase 2 and Power Supply Contract for Cross Island Line Awarded
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the final civil contract for the design and construction of tunnels between Maju station (working name) and Clementi station for Cross Island Line Phase 2, along with a separate contract for the CRL\u2019s power supply system. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Enhancing Pedestrian Safety on Public Paths
item.description: As our population ages and active mobility grows in popularity for first-mile last-mile journeys, we are also doing more to keep our paths safe, especially for seniors and young children. Currently, over 200km of the cycling paths are built adjacent to footpaths. LTA will be converting these footpaths adjacent to dedicated cycling paths into Pedestrian-Only Paths. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Expanding Singapore’s Electric Vehicle Charging Infrastructure
item.description: Singapore\u2019s electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure is expanding steadily across public HDB carparks and private premises, sustaining the momentum of our transition to cleaner energy vehicles. Please refer to the attached factsheet for more information.

item.title: Enhancements to Road Network in Tuas South to Support Future Development
item.description: To support the industrial developments in Tuas South and the consolidation of Singapore\u2019s container port activities at Tuas over the next decade, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will commence works to enhance the road network in Tuas South. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: First Two New Bukit Panjang Light Rail Vehicles to Commence Passenger Service from 1 August
item.description: Two new third-generation Light Rail Vehicles for the Bukit Panjang LRT (BPLRT) will enter passenger service from 1 August 2024. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contract for Design and Construction of CRL Jurong Lake District Station and Tunnels under the Cross Island Line Phase 2
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the civil contract for the design and construction of CR19 Jurong Lake District station (working name) and tunnels under the Cross Island Line (CRL) Phase 2. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Teck Lee LRT Station to Start Operations on 15 August 2024
item.description: Teck Lee LRT station will start operations on 15 August 2024. Please refer to the attached news release for more information.

item.title: Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme to Better Serve Commuter Needs
item.description: The Land Transport Authority will be launching the Bus Connectivity Enhancement Programme to better serve commuter needs. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for August 2024 to October 2024
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for Aug 2024 to Oct 2024 will be 15,283. Overall, the COE quota for August 2024 to October 2024 is 1% higher than last quarter (May 2024 to July 2024). Compared to the last quarter, the COE quota for Categories A, B and C increased by 1-5% whilst Category D quota remained unchanged. Details of the quota for each COE category are in Annex A. Bidding under this quota will start on 5 August 2024. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: SBS Transit Ltd to Continue Operating Seletar Bus Package
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the contract for Seletar bus package to SBS Transit Ltd (SBST) today. Please find more details in the attached release.

item.title: Registration of Diesel Car and Taxi to Cease on 1 January 2025 in Line with Push for Cleaner Energy Models
item.description: As announced at the Ministry of Transport\u2019s Committee of Supply 2021, all new diesel car and taxi registrations will cease from 2025. This supports Singapore\u2019s vision for all vehicles to run on cleaner energy by 2040. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Tengah Bus Interchange to Start Operations On 21 July 2024
item.description: Commuters in Tengah can look forward to improved transport connectivity with the opening of Tengah Bus Interchange (BI) on Sunday, 21 July 2024. Located along Tengah Boulevard, the new BI will be managed by Tower Transit Singapore. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contract for Design and Construction of Tunnels Between CRL West Coast Station and Jurong Lake District Station for Cross Island Line Phase 2
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the civil contract for the design and construction of tunnels between the West Coast station (CR18) and Jurong Lake District station (CR19) (working names) for Cross Island Line Phase 2. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SBS Transit - Temporary Service Adjustments on North East Line for Integration of New Punggol Coast Station
item.description: As part of ongoing rail expansion works, the Land Transport Authority and SBS Transit will carry out a series of works to integrate the new Punggol Coast station to the existing North East Line (NEL) network. To facilitate these testing and commissioning works, train services on the NEL will start later at 8.00am on four consecutive Sundays from 30 Jun to 21 Jul 2024. To minimise the impact of these temporary service adjustments, alternative travel options will be provided for affected commuters on these days. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for the details.

item.title: Four New Sandbox Trials to Grow the Electric Vehicle Charging Ecosystem
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has approved four sandbox trials for battery charging and swapping system (BCSS) for electric heavy goods vehicles (e-HGVs) and mobile charging systems (MCS). Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Factsheet: Explore Seven New Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 4 Stations on 21 June
item.description: LTA invites commuters to a special public preview event \u201CJourney through Colours of the East\u201D on 21 June 2024 from 12.00pm to 9.00pm, to familiarise themselves with the seven new Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 4 (TEL4) stations before they open for passenger service on 23 June. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contract for Design and Construction of CRL Turf City Station and Tunnels under the Cross Island Line Phase 2
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the civil contract for the design and construction of CR14 Turf City station (working name) and tunnels under the Cross Island Line Phase 2. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Revised ERP Rates for June 2024 School Holiday Period
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates for the June 2024 school holidays. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Enhancements to ERP 2.0 On-Board Unit Installation
item.description: We would like to share some updates on the ongoing ERP 2.0 on-board unit (OBU) installation, as well as our considerations underlying its design and how we have progressively fine-tuned our installation processes. Please see the attached release for more information.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for May 2024 to July 2024
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for May 2024 to July 2024 will be 15,104. 266 Cat E Temporary COEs (TCOEs) that expired between January 2024 to March 2024 will be available for bidding in May 2024 to July 2024. The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will redistribute these expired Cat E TCOEs to Cat A, B and C in proportion to their respective contributions to Cat E. Details of the quota for each COE category are in Annex A. Bidding under this quota will start on 6 May 2024. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: ERP 2.0 On-Board Unit Installation Extended to New Vehicles and Existing Motorcycles from 1 May 2024
item.description: The installation of the ERP 2.0 system\u2019s on-board unit (OBU) in fleet vehicles is progressing as scheduled. Over 13,000 vehicles have been fitted with OBUs since November 2023. From 13 February 2024, OBU installation has also commenced for new motorcycles. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Thomson – East Coast Line 4 to Welcome Commuters from 23 June 2024
item.description: As announced at the Ministry of Transport\u2019s Committee of Supply debate today, the Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 4 (TEL4) will commence passenger service on 23 June this year. TEL4 will improve accessibility for commuters by linking Singapore\u2019s newest rail line with the East Coast region. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Additional $1 Billion to Encourage More Walk Cycle Ride Journeys
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will step up efforts to facilitate Walk, Cycle, Ride journeys. First, LTA will expand its Friendly Streets initiative to more towns. Second, LTA will improve first-and-last-mile connectivity with more commuter infrastructure. These two initiatives, which are also in support of Age Well SG, will receive additional funding of around $1 billion over the next decade. LTA will additionally fund two new road repurposing projects to prioritise road space for pedestrians and cyclists. These enhancements aim to create safer, more inclusive public spaces, and encourage active and sustainable modes of transport. Please refer to the attached release for more details.\n

item.title: Factsheet: Progress Update on Review of Point-to-Point Transport Industry Structure and Regulatory Framework
item.description: As announced at the Ministry of Transport\u2019s Committee of Supply 2024, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) has been engaging various stakeholders on the review of the Point-to-Point Transport (P2P) industry structure and regulatory framework. While the review is still ongoing, LTA will be making several changes to address key areas of feedback received thus far. Please refer to the attached factsheet for more details.

item.title: New CBT Cards Available for Eligible Commuters from 18 March 2024
item.description: With the extension of the existing adult card-based ticketing (CBT) system until at least 2030, CBT cards will be made available to (i) adult commuters who converted to SimplyGo or purchased a SimplyGo EZ-Link or NETS Prepaid Card between 9 and 22 January 2024, as well as (ii) concession cardholders who were issued or converted their cards to SimplyGo on or before 22 January 2024. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: Car-Free Sunday to Return Next Month
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA), Health Promotion Board (HPB), Housing & Development Board (HDB), National Parks Board (NParks), Sport Singapore (SportSG) and Urban Redevelopment Authority are working in collaboration to bring Car-Free Sunday to the Civic District and the Central Business District (CBD) on Sunday, 17 March 2024. Car-Free Sunday 2024 promotes Singapore\u2019s car-lite goal by creating greater public awareness of the benefits of walking, cycling and riding public transport as sustainable ways to travel. On Car-Free Sunday, designated roads in the Civic District and CBD will be closed to allow the public to enjoy activities on the streets without vehicular traffic. Through such interactions, we also hope to encourage pedestrians and Active Mobility device users to adopt etiquettes to share space safely and harmoniously. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: GST Refunds for Nine Regulatory Fees
item.description: As announced by the Ministry of Finance, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be refunding the Goods and Services Tax (GST) charged for nine fees that are regulatory in nature for payments made within the last five years since 1 January 2019. These fees, for which GST should not be charged, are no longer charged GST. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: No Changes to ERP Rates
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its latest review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contract for Design and Construction of Maju Station and Tunnels
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the civil contract for the design and construction of Maju station (working name) and tunnels under the Cross Island Line Phase 2. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COEs) Quota for February 2024 to April 2024
item.description: The Certificate of Entitlement (COE) quota for February 2024 to April 2024 will be 14,707. Increase in quota for Categories A, B and C. From this quarter onwards, the Land Transport Authority will bring forward the guaranteed deregistrations of 5-year non-extendable Category D COEs to reduce quota supply volatility. Bidding under this quota will start on 5 February 2024. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Card Exchange for SimplyGo EZ-Link and Concession Cardholders
item.description: As announced by Transport Minister Chee Hong Tat, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will be extending the existing adult card-based ticketing (CBT) system, to operate in parallel with the SimplyGo system. The extension will continue to give adult commuters the option of using the EZ-Link and NETS FlashPay cards or their SimplyGo-compatible cards on public transport. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority & SMRT - Reminder on Service Adjustments on Circle Line to Facilitate Rail Expansion Works
item.description: To facilitate track works for the integration of Stage 6 of the Circle Line (CCL) with the existing network, commuters are reminded of upcoming service adjustments to the CCL starting next week. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Updates on the Johor Bahru – Singapore Rapid Transit System Link
item.description: The RTS Link is a 4-kilometre rail shuttle service between the Singapore terminus at Woodlands North station and the Malaysia terminus at Bukit Chagar station in Johor Bahru, with a peak capacity of up to 10,000 passengers per hour in each direction. Passengers will enjoy a fast and seamless travel experience between Singapore and Johor Bahru on the RTS Link, with a train journey time of about five minutes between the two stations. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: EZ-Link Adult Cardholders and NETS FlashPay Cardholders to Transit to SimplyGo for Public Transport Fare Payments by 1 June
item.description: From 1 June 2024, the Land Transport Authority (LTA) will no longer be accepting two types of legacy stored value cards for public transport fare payment \u2013 EZ-Link adult cards which have not yet been upgraded to SimplyGo EZ-Link, and NETS FlashPay cards. These two cards can continue to be used for motoring-related payments such as Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) and parking charges. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Opening of New Flyover Connects Seletar Link to Tampines Expressway (TPE)
item.description: The Seletar Link Flyover will open on 22 January 2024 at 2.00pm. This new flyover will provide a new connection from Seletar Link to the Tampines Expressway (Central Expressway\/ Seletar Expressway) (TPE (CTE\/ SLE)), as well as between Tampines Expressway (Kallang-Paya Lebar Expressway\/ Pan Island Expressway) (TPE (KPE\/ PIE)) and Seletar Link. The new flyover will support the expected increase in traffic due to new developments in Punggol Town and Pulau Punggol Timor. For more details, kindly refer to attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority & National Arts Council - Experience art on the go: NAC and LTA partner to bring public art to commuter spaces
item.description: SINGAPORE, 8 January 2024 \u2013 The National Arts Council (NAC) and Land Transport Authority (LTA) announced a three-year partnership to bring the arts closer to the public in land transport spaces and public transport commutes, through commissioned works by Singapore artists and arts organisations. The partnership kicks off today with the launch of the themed train and stations in support of Singapore Art Week 2024. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Pilot for New Street-Level Wayfinding System in Central Area and Yishun
item.description: As part of LTA\u2019s continuous efforts to make walking and cycling journeys to key amenities more convenient and accessible, LTA will be piloting a new wayfinding system in the Central area and Yishun starting this month. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: Enforcement Action Against Errant Taxi Drivers for Overcharging Offences
item.description: On 15 December 2023, LTA took enforcement action against seven taxi drivers for overcharging offences under Section 41(7) of the Public Transport Council Act 1987. Please refer to the news release attached for more details.

item.title: The Rail Report: Construction in Full Swing for Jurong Region Line and Cross Island Line with More New Stations Opening in Coming Years
item.description: Singapore\u2019s rail network serves over 3 million rides each day. The Land Transport Authority (LTA) is continuously expanding the rail system, preserving rail reliability, and enhancing commuter infrastructure to strengthen the connectivity and resilience of our rail network. For more details on 2023 in review and upcoming initiatives that commuters can look forward to, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Factsheet: Commencement of Electric Vehicles Charging Act 2022 on 8 December 2023
item.description: The Electric Vehicles Charging Act 2022 (\u201CEVCA\u201D), which regulates the safe charging of electric vehicles (\u201CEV\u201D), ensures the provision of reliable EV charging services, and expands the network of accessible charging infrastructure in Singapore, will commence on 8 December 2023. For more details, please refer to the attached factsheet.

item.title: LTA Awards Civil Contract for Design and Construction of West Coast Station under Cross Island Line Phase 2
item.description: The Land Transport Authority has awarded the civil contract for the design and construction of West Coast station and tunnels under the Cross Island Line Phase 2. Please refer to the news release attached in this email for more information.

item.title: Construction for Friendly Streets Pilots Begins with Strong Community Support
item.description: Acting Minister for Transport Mr Chee Hong Tat today marked the commencement of works at the first of five Friendly Streets pilot locations at Bukit Batok West and launched the logo for the Friendly Streets initiative. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: LTA Media Statement on Bus Service 167
item.description: We earlier announced changes to several bus services to reallocate finite bus resources by reducing duplication with Thomson-East Coast Line (TEL) service. We understand that some commuters may need more time to adjust, especially so for Service 167, where the change is more extensive. As such, we will retain Service 167 for now and operate it at 30-minute intervals throughout the day. For more details, please refer to the attached reply.

item.title: Launch of Inaugural RailTech Grand Challenge in Conjunction with Annual Singapore BusTech Grand Challenge
item.description: The third Singapore BusTech Grand Challenge and the inaugural Singapore RailTech Grand Challenge took place today at the Institute of Education (ITE) West College. Acting Minister for Transport, Mr Chee Hong Tat, attended the event and presented awards to winning bus and rail teams. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: More Electric Buses to be Deployed from December 2024
item.description: The third Singapore BusTech Grand Challenge and the inaugural Singapore RailTech Grand Challenge took place today at the Institute of Education (ITE) West College. Acting Minister for Transport, Mr Chee Hong Tat, attended the event and presented awards to winning bus and rail teams. At the event, Mr Chee announced the first large-scale award of contracts for new electric buses and the charging systems to support the electrification of Singapore\u2019s public bus fleet. Two contracts to procure a total of 360 electric buses and another two contracts for the deployment of charging systems in bus depots at Sengkang West, East Coast and Gali Batu were awarded. For more details, kindly refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Public Transport Emergency Preparedness Exercise at Woodlands MRT Station
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) and SMRT Trains will conduct Exercise Station Guard, an emergency preparedness exercise, on 30 November 2023, from 10.00am to 4.00pm at Woodlands MRT station (North-South Line and Thomson-East Coast Line). You may refer to the attached for more details please. \n

item.title: Ridership on TEL almost tripled with introduction of TEL3
item.description: Since the opening of the Thomson-East Coast Line Stage 3 (TEL3), the average weekday ridership on TEL has almost tripled from 60,000 in October 2022 to 177,000 in October 2023. At the same time, ridership for some bus services plying along segments of TEL has seen an overall decrease of around 30 to 40 percent. To reduce duplication of bus services with TEL and to reallocate finite resources to better serve residents from new estates within our towns, adjustments to some bus services will be implemented from 10 December 2023. Please refer to the attached for more details.

item.title: ERP rates for the December 2023 School Holiday Period
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has completed its review of Electronic Road Pricing (ERP) rates for the December 2023 school holidays. Please refer to the attached release for more details.

item.title: LTA Awards Road Assets Advertising Operator Contract to Stellar Experience
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) has awarded the contract for the road assets Advertising Operator (AO) tender to Stellar Experience Private Limited. Under the tender, the AO will be granted a 10-year concession, starting from 1 January 2024, to manage and operate the advertising spaces at LTA-owned bus and taxi shelters as well as designated pedestrian infrastructure, with an option to extend for another six years. Please refer to the news release attached for more details.

item.title: Joint Factsheet by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), PTC & Caring SG Commuters Committee - Recognising Our Public Transport Workers and Commuters for Going the Extra Mile
item.description: The Caring SG Commuters Committee, the Land Transport Authority (LTA), and the Public Transport Council (PTC), in partnership with the National Transport Workers\u2019 Union (NTWU) and public transport operators (PTOs), held two concurrent events dedicated to our transport workers and commuters today. Both were held at the integrated lifestyle hub One Punggol. Please refer to the factsheet attached for more information.

item.title: Jurong Town Hall Bus Interchange to Open on 26 November 2023
item.description: Commuters in Western Singapore can look forward to more inclusive public transport facilities with the opening of the new Jurong Town Hall Bus Interchange (JTHBI) on Sunday, 26 November 2023. The new bus interchange will be managed by Tower Transit Singapore. Please refer to the news release attached for more details.

This is on top of the 1,895 reallocated COEs that was announced on 13 October. A breakdown of the COE quota by the various categories is in the table below. item.title: Completion of First Phase of the Singapore Rail Test Centre
item.description: The Land Transport Authority today announced the completion of the first phase of the Singapore Rail Test Centre (SRTC), including the operationalisation of its high speed test track. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA) & SMRT - Reminder on Service Adjustments on Thomson-East Coast Line to Facilitate Rail Expansion Works
item.description: Commuters are reminded of the upcoming service adjustments on the Thomson-East Coast Line (TEL) to facilitate the integrated testing of systems in TEL stages 1 to 4, in preparation for TEL stage 4 next year. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Request for Proposal for Master Plan Consultancy for North-South Corridor’s Surface Streets
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) launched a Request for Proposal (RFP) today, inviting consultancy firms with expertise in landscape architecture, urban design, public space design, placemaking and active mobility to develop a Master Plan for the surface streets along the North-South Corridor (NSC). item.title: Joint News Release by the Land Transport Authority (LTA), SBS Transit & SMRT - Joint LTA-Operator Exercise to Ensure Operational Readiness in Managing Rail Incidents
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) conducted a joint ground deployment exercise with rail operators SBS Transit (SBST) and SMRT at Outram Park MRT station today. Codenamed \u2018Exercise GREYHOUND 2023\u2019, the exercise was conducted during engineering hours this morning and plays a key role in our ongoing efforts to maintain a high level of operational readiness in managing major incidents in the public transport network. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Completion of the North-South and East-West Lines’ Six Core Systems Renewal
item.description: The Land Transport Authority today marked the completion of the multi-year programme to renew and upgrade the North-South and East-West lines. This is Singapore\u2019s most significant rail network improvement effort to date. Please refer to the attached news release for more details.

item.title: ERP 2.0 On-Board Unit Installation Starting in November with Fleet Vehicles
item.description: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) will begin installation of the new on-board unit (OBU) under the ERP 2.0 system in phases from next month, starting with fleet vehicles. For more details, please refer to the attached news release.

item.title: Certificate of Entitlement (COE) Quota for November 2023 to January 2024
